evidence.title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Stopping Verbatim Loops at Sampling Time
XTC: Head-Aware Sampling by Excluding Top Choices

summary: Researchers introduce XTC, a head-aware sampling method that excludes top token choices to stop AI models from repeating phrases verbatim. The approach improves coherence in generated text by dynamically adjusting sampling probabilities.
title: New AI Sampling Technique 'XTC' Prevents Verbatim Repetition in Text Generation
